claims.content: The Auctioneer wants to schedule new auction events with flexibility in selecting products, applying them to particular events, and setting timeframes.

scope_contract.goal_statement: The Auctioneer wants to schedule new auction events with flexibility in selecting products, applying them to particular events, and setting timeframes.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: The Auctioneer accesses the Create New Auctions Page and schedules a new auction event with selected products applied to that event and timeframes set.
scope_contract.start_boundary: The Auctioneer begins from the Auction Admin Main Menu and accesses the Create New Auctions Page.
scope_contract.success_boundary: A new auction event is scheduled with the selected products applied to the event and the timeframes set.
in_scope_actions: Access the Create New Auctions Page from the Auction Admin Main Menu.
Select products for the new auction event.
Apply selected products to the particular event.
Schedule timeframes for the new auction event.
excluded_adjacent_actions: Defining auction profile settings as a separate profile-management activity.
Pursuing the platform's overall business goal of building the best business-to-consumer auction site.
variant_dimensions: Which particular event the products are applied to

claims.content: Auctioneer
The Auctioneer is logged into the system.
The Auctioneer has accessed the Create New Auctions Page from the Auction Admin Main Menu.
The Auctioneer accesses the Create New Auctions Page from the Auction Admin Main Menu to begin scheduling a new auction event.
The Auctioneer accesses the Create New Auctions Page from the Auction Admin Main Menu Page to begin scheduling a new auction event.

The Auctioneer uses the Search Section to find products by selecting criteria from scrolling list boxes such as Retail Category, Product Type, Gemstone Type, Material Type, Material Purity, and Brand, entering cost ranges, or searching by SKU number with wildcards.

The system displays matching products in a results table containing columns such as Action, Item thumbnail image, Product ID, Description, Reserve, Item Unit Cost, Quantity Available, and various attributes.
The Auctioneer selects specific items for the auction by checking the Action column checkboxes next to the desired products.
The Auctioneer selects one of the event profiles from a list box displaying available event profiles.
The Auctioneer clicks the Apply button to apply the selected event profile to all selected items.
The Auctioneer sets the auction timeframes by choosing from standard durations such as 20-Minute, 1-hour, or 1 Day, or by manually specifying start and end dates/times.
The Auctioneer confirms the schedule and creates the event by clicking the Create New Auction button, which creates an auction event for all selected items with their applied parameters.
The Auctioneer may locate products by entering cost ranges.
The Auctioneer may locate products by searching by SKU number with wildcards.
Diverges from step 7: The Auctioneer may set the auction timeframe by manually specifying start and end dates/times rather than choosing a standard duration.

Diverges from main_flow step 6: If the Auctioneer chooses 'Apply to Gemstones Only' and then attempts to apply that event profile to a grouping of jewelry items, the system generates an error message telling the Auctioneer that this profile can only be applied to products in the gemstone category (retail category = gemstones).

Diverges from main_flow step 8: If any of the items being scheduled have additional quantities of the same item already scheduled in overlapping auction events, the system provides a warning, preferably via a popup window, to the Auctioneer before the auction is created.

Diverges from main_flow step 8: If the Auctioneer attempts to create an auction with the same starting and ending date/time, the system prevents the auction from being created, displays an error message, and highlights (color-codes) the offending data.

missing_aspects: Recovery or exit path after the gemstone-only profile category mismatch error, including how the Auctioneer changes the profile or product selection and resumes.
Recovery or exit path after the overlapping-auction warning, including whether the Auctioneer may proceed, cancel, or return to product selection.
Recovery or exit path after the same starting and ending date/time validation error, including how the Auctioneer corrects the timeframes and resumes.
Recovery or exit path after the overlapping-auction warning
Recovery or exit path after the gemstone-only profile category mismatch error
Recovery or exit path after the same starting and ending date/time validation error
Explicit recovery or exit behavior following the warning

claims.content: A new auction event is scheduled with the selected products applied to that event, their applied parameters (event profile or manual settings), and the timeframes set.
For each item in the auction event, the opening time is system-generated based on the filled-in duration and ending time.
No product without an available image or not in a valid, sellable inventory location is eligible for scheduling in the new auction event.
